summary: Lower the comma operator by evaluating the left expression for GetValue side effects, discarding it, then evaluating and returning the right value.

target.notes: The compiler intrinsic must evaluate left and perform GetValue even though its value is discarded, then evaluate right and return GetValue(right).

caveats: C# has no general comma expression equivalent.
Do not implement with lambdas when await/yield/control-flow capture would alter semantics; statement-level temporaries may be required.

tests.name: edge left getter side effect preserved
tests.input: let n=0; const o={get x(){n++; return 1}}; console.log((o.x, 7), n);
